summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Diagnosis (read-only investigation, no changes made)  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → SQLite.  **What I found is correctly wired:** - Frontend uses `credentials: "include"` on every request, no localStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere in the watchlist flow. - `watchlists` table has a mandatory `user_id` column; every query (list/get/create/delete/add-item/remove-item) filters by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`. - The watchlist router has its own auth middleware that validates the `arca_session`
